# AgentShare

> Local review and selective HTML/Markdown export for explicitly supplied Claude Code or Codex JSONL transcripts. Common pattern redaction; tool bodies omitted; nothing selected initially. Manual review is required before sharing.

## Documentation

- [Project](https://fuxing0910-hue.github.io/agentshare/): English overview and runnable synthetic demo.
- [中文介绍](https://fuxing0910-hue.github.io/agentshare/zh.html): Chinese overview.
- [Redact and export a Claude Code/Codex transcript](https://fuxing0910-hue.github.io/agentshare/claude-code-transcript-review.html): bilingual task guide with offline review, edit/select, HTML/Markdown export and install commands.
- [Agent integration](https://github.com/fuxing0910-hue/agentshare/blob/main/docs/agents.md): portable Skill, CLI and local function dispatcher; OpenAI Responses, DeepSeek Chat Completions, Claude Messages, Gemini Interactions declaration formats.
- [Skill](https://github.com/fuxing0910-hue/agentshare/blob/main/skills/share-ai-transcripts/SKILL.md): installed-agent routing and bundled standalone runner.
- [Technical reference](https://github.com/fuxing0910-hue/agentshare/blob/main/docs/reference.md): supported inputs, local processing and privacy limitations.
- [Releases](https://github.com/fuxing0910-hue/agentshare/releases): versioned wheel and portable skill assets.

This is a documentation index. Tool use requires an installed skill, local runtime or an API application that registers the function declarations. It does not register tools in public chat applications.
